headline: Refresh the vendored framework and the runtime base image
summary: A maintenance release. Nothing about how the client talks to a server changes, and no configuration needs revisiting.

items.title: The vendored framework moves to 0.18.27
items.body: Passkey verification moves onto the certificate toolkit already vendored here, and the separate WebAuthn library it used is gone from the tree. Manufacturer attestations are anchored to pinned vendor roots, binary fields in a response must be canonically encoded, and a response must name the one credential type the specification defines. None of this is on the path this client uses to reach a server; it ships because the framework is vendored whole.

items.title: The runtime base image moves to the current Chainguard rebuild
items.body: The pinned digest had been superseded upstream. Bumping it picks up whatever package fixes landed in the rebuild.
